body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> MSI introduced its new ultra-slim 13-inch notebook pc 'X320' at the pre-press event '2009 CES Unveiled'.

With a maximum thickness of about 1.98 cm and just 6mm thick in parts, it's even thinner than a packet of tissues. As it's also the first ultra-slim notebook in the world to be equipped with the latest 16:9 LED display, the X-Slim Series X320 is set to become MSI's power seller for 2009.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
